checks: Different uploaded asset is not clobbered
Different existing tag or release target is preserved
Only HTTP404 is treated as absence, not403 or network failure
Unauthenticated download is pinned to the exact GitHub release URL
Successful flow uploads and downloads exact bytes before changing the feed
Wrong public bytes prevent feed mutation
Repeated completed invocation does not duplicate upload or feed writes
note: This validates the control flow, not the owner's credentials, release permissions, local cached files or real upload. The existing owner-Mac command must perform those checks and report the result.
